title: Critical Flaw in Canonical LXD and MicroCloud Allows Impersonation
excerpt: A critical vulnerability in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud lets attackers log in as trusted clients without needing a private key.
body_html:
A critical security vulnerability carrying a maximum CVSS score of 10.0 has been identified in Canonical's LXD and MicroCloud software. The flaw allows malicious actors to authenticate as trusted clients without possessing the required private key.

To exploit this issue, an attacker needs network access to the HTTPS API alongside the public certificate of a trusted client. Successful exploitation grants the attacker the ability to act as the impersonated client, providing access to the cluster and associated virtual machines.
